name: genre-vampire-erotic-gothic
description: Use when recreating late-1960s/1970s erotic vampire cinema: photochemical 35mm, glamour-grade dark gothic, theatrical chiaroscuro. Pick exactly one style family (Hammer technicolor, Karnstein erotic, Rollin surrealist, Franco zoom, Art-deco, Iberian rural, giallo, grindhouse, psychedelic occult). Do NOT use for modern dark-fantasy spectacle, VHS home video (genre-vhs-domestic), or contemporary horror; those read as wrong.
